values.note: RV dump station for a $15 fee. Indoor restrooms with hot showers (ADA). Water spigots near primitive sites. Two pavilions with a stage, playground, creek and walking paths. Quiet generators only in designated areas, 10 am-8 pm.

note: Formerly Sertoma Youth Ranch; 80-acre wooded music-festival and camping ranch between Brooksville and Dade City, with a spring-fed creek and walking trails. RV storage. Festivals occasionally take over the whole ranch and close general camping - check the event calendar before going. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the operator's Visit/FAQ/Rules pages: $35 water/electric sites (4 people, +$13 each extra; primitive $25; fees as recorded), FCFS on non-festival days with email/phone reservations, hot showers, $15 dump station, year-round. Added potable water, season, booking details. Note trimmed of rate/FCFS/shower/length facts (its $20 primitive price is now $25). Not stated on the current pages: amperage, max rig length 50 ft and pull-throughs (left as recorded), exact site count.
flags: Website is dead: https://floridasandmusicranch.com/camping-rates/ returns 'Page not found'; the operator's rates and camping page is now https://floridasandmusicranch.com/visit/.

Event venue check: it is a festival venue AND a year-round campground - 'open camping available on all non festival days, and during some festivals that do not take over the entire property'; festival weekends are priced and run by the promoters. Passes as a campground, with that caveat.

Price gate: base $35/night (tax included, up to 4 people), under US$50 - passes. Nearest gateway: none within 40 km (Tampa 57 km, Walt Disney World 70 km). The family has not stayed here (no trip references).

The Visit page's 'How to get here' text is template boilerplate that is wrong for this ranch ('We're off Highway 27 near Lake Wales', 'about two hours from Orlando'); the same page gives the ranch's address as 85 Myers Rd, Brooksville, FL 34602. Coordinates in the entry not affected.
